ops.text: When a handoff authors verbatim SKILL.md prose, dry-run it against the residual-guard grep (the retired-signature list in test_relocated_doctrine_leaves_no_residual_in_carrier_skill_md) BEFORE dispatch — a load-bearing verbatim body that re-pastes single-sourced doctrine trips the move-8 no-residual test and costs a rework round-trip. Fix is pointer-not-paste, never a test carve-out.

An external-backend crew returned for rework sometimes applies the file edit but idles before rewriting its result document, leaving a stale verdict. Judge from the completed artifact (diff) + own world-verification per the idle-crew-at-integrate rule; a tighter 'your FINAL action is rewriting the result doc' nudge reduces it.
